items.difficulty_reason: 28 行、生成元的经典论证：①right-orthogonal 引理把 Hom 消失从 E 扩到 ⟨E⟩ 整个子范畴；②construct-the-next-one 引理（本线 L22095）从 E 的直和项构造 O_X(-n-1)，归纳得到所有负次扭 O_X(-m)；③Hom(O(-m), K[p]) = H^p(X, K⊗O(m))（= K⊗O(1)^{⊗m} 的上同调）；④ample 检测引理（nonzero-some-cohomology，本线 L22122）：O_X(1) 充足 ⇒ 若所有扭上同调为零则 K=0。承重全在 span 内；5 处引用（2 同章、3 跨章）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-generator-P1 (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 4371-4381

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the closure of the right orthogonal under the subcategory generated by E, the construction of arbitrarily negative twists of the structure sheaf from E via the resolution lemma for projective space, the rewriting of Hom from a twist as twisted cohomology, and the annihilation of the hypothetical nonzero object by the ampleness detection lemma (source lines 4383-4410)
